```{r Data Preprocessing}
library(disdat)
library(mgcv)
library(sf)
library(spatstat)
library(fields)
library(tmap)
library(grid)
library(units)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(glmnet)
library(scampr)
#install.packages("glmmTMB_1.1.9-9000.tar.gz",  repos = NULL, type = "source")
library(glmmTMB)

# get the data
source("get_and_format_flora_data.R")
rm(dat_pa)

# get a vector of the factor terms
facts <- c("disturb", "soilfert", "vegsis")

# load the species information
load("flora_species.RDATA")

# get the groups to which the flora species belongs to subset the data
flora_groups <- unique(sp.info$group)

# subset the presence-only data (in the case we are using restricted species)
pres <- pres[pres$group %in% flora_groups, ]

# want to use species with at least 10 presences
pres <- pres[pres$spid %in% names(table(pres$spid))[table(pres$spid) >= 10], ]

# get the species
species <- unique(pres$spid)

# assign some numbers
m <- length(species) # responses
q <- nrow(quad) # quadrature points

# add in the quadrature for each species (replicates of the supplied background points)
tmp <- quad[rep(seq_len(q), m), ]
tmp$spid <- rep(species, each = q) # assign the species id's
dat <- rbind(pres, tmp)
n <- nrow(dat)
rm(tmp)

# set the coordinates to x and y so we can just use default labels
dat$lon <- dat$x; dat$lat <- dat$y; dat$x <- dat$xm; dat$y <- dat$ym; dat$xm <- NULL; dat$ym <- NULL

load("domain.RDATA")
domain$lon <- domain$x; domain$lat <- domain$y; domain$x <- domain$xm; domain$y <- domain$ym; domain$xm <- NULL; domain$ym <- NULL

gc()
```


```{r Intensity map}
dat_rename = dat %>% 
  mutate(spid = as.numeric(str_extract(spid, "\\d+")))
# Presence points for selected species
species_points = dat_rename[dat_rename$occ == 1 & dat_rename$spid %in% 18:23, ]
species_points_lonlat = st_as_sf(species_points, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
species_points_lonlat$spid = factor(species_points_lonlat$spid)
# Study-region boundary
border_lonlat = disBorder("NSW")

# Drawing map
tmap_mode("plot")
bbox_wide = st_bbox(border_lonlat)
bbox_wide["xmin"] = bbox_wide["xmin"] - 0.5
my_cols = c("#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833", "#CCBB44",
            "#66CCEE", "#AA3377", "#BBBBBB", "#000000")

map_sel_species <- tm_shape(border_lonlat, bbox = bbox_wide) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_shape(species_points_lonlat) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.4, col = "spid", shape = 4, col_alpha = 0.8, col.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = my_cols), col.legend = tm_legend(title = "Species", title.size = 0.6)) + # add the points
  tm_compass(type = "8star", position = c("left", "top")) + # add north arrow
  tm_grid(lwd = 0.2, labels.inside.frame = FALSE, alpha = 0.4, crs = 4326) + # add the grid
  tm_xlab("          Longitude (º)", size = 0.6) +
  tm_ylab("Latitude (º)", size = 0.6)
tmap_save(map_sel_species, "figures/map_sel_species.png", width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```


```{r Intensity map for one species}
dat_rename = dat %>% 
  mutate(spid = as.numeric(str_extract(spid, "\\d+")))
# Presence points for one species
species_points = dat_rename[dat_rename$occ == 1 & dat_rename$spid %in% 19, ]
species_points_lonlat = st_as_sf(species_points, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
species_points_lonlat$spid = factor(species_points_lonlat$spid)
# Quadrature points 
quad_points = dat_rename[dat_rename$occ == 0 & dat_rename$spid %in% 19, ]
quad_points_lonlat = st_as_sf(quad_points, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
quad_points_lonlat$spid = factor(quad_points_lonlat$spid)
# Study-region boundary
border_lonlat = disBorder("NSW")

# Drawing map
tmap_mode("plot")
bbox_wide = st_bbox(border_lonlat)
bbox_wide["xmin"] = bbox_wide["xmin"] - 0.5
my_cols = c("#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833", "#CCBB44",
            "#66CCEE", "#AA3377", "#BBBBBB", "#000000")

map_one_species <- tm_shape(border_lonlat, bbox = bbox_wide) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_shape(species_points_lonlat) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.4, col = "spid", shape = 4, col_alpha = 0.8, col.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = my_cols), col.legend = tm_legend(title = "Species", title.size = 0.6)) + # add the points
  tm_shape(quad_points_lonlat) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.05, col = "black", shape = 16, col_alpha = 0.5) + # add the points
  tm_compass(type = "8star", position = c("left", "top")) + # add north arrow
  tm_grid(lwd = 0.2, labels.inside.frame = FALSE, alpha = 0.4, crs = 4326) + # add the grid
  tm_xlab("          Longitude (º)", size = 0.6) +
  tm_ylab("Latitude (º)", size = 0.6)
tmap_save(map_one_species, "presentation/figures/map_one_species.png", width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```


```{r}
library(disdat)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)

# disdat study region
nsw_region = st_as_sf(disBorder("NSW"))

# Australia polygon
australia = ne_countries(country = "Australia", returnclass = "sf")

# make sure CRS matches
nsw_region = st_transform(nsw_region, st_crs(australia))

tmap_mode("plot")

map_aus = tm_shape(australia) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "#234F1E", col = "grey40") +
  tm_shape(nsw_region) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "#7B3F00", col = "black") +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE)

tmap_save(map_aus, "presentation/figures/disdatnsw.png", width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```


```{r}
domain_sf = st_as_sf(domain, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

map_mi =
  tm_shape(domain_sf) +
  tm_dots(
    fill = "mi",
    size = 0.03,
    col = NA,
    fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Moisture index")
  ) +
  tm_shape(disBorder("NSW")) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", position = c("left", "top")) +
  tm_xlab("Longitude") +
  tm_ylab("Latitude") +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE)

map_temp =
  tm_shape(domain_sf) +
  tm_dots(
    fill = "tempann",
    size = 0.03,
    col = NA,
    fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Mean annual temperature")
  ) +
  tm_shape(disBorder("NSW")) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", position = c("left", "top")) +
  tm_xlab("Longitude") +
  tm_ylab("Latitude") +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE)

```


```{r}
combine_intro_maps = tmap_arrange(map_aus, map_sel_species, map_mi, map_temp, nrow = 2)
tmap_save(combine_intro_maps, "figures/combine_intro_maps.png", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
source("obtain_format_data.R")
source("build_basis_functions.R")
# Rename spid
dat_rename = dat %>% 
  mutate(spid = as.numeric(str_extract(spid, "\\d+")))

attach(dat_rename)
mlgcp_glm_joint = mlgcp_alt_glm(u = cbind(rnorm(ncol(Z_star), 0, 1), rnorm(ncol(Z_star), 0, 1)), data = dat, Z = Z_star, X = cbind(1, mi, tempann), N = 1000, max_it = 3, Y = occ/wt, wts = wt)
```

```{r Intensity map for a chosen species}

X_domain = cbind(1, domain$mi, domain$tempann)
Z_domain_star = bf_matrix(bfs, domain[, c("x", "y")])

Zu_domain = Z_domain_star %*% u

target_species_id <- 19
j = match(target_species_id, chosen_spid)

sp_fld_glmnet = X_domain %*% beta[j, ] + Zu_domain %*% lambda[j, ]

domain$log_intensity = as.numeric(sp_fld_glmnet[, 1])

library(stars)
domain_stars = st_as_stars(domain[, c("lon", "lat", "log_intensity")], dims = c("lon", "lat"))
grid_pred_lonlat = domain_stars

species_points = dat_rename[dat_rename$spid == target_species_id & dat_rename$occ == 1, ]
species_points_lonlat = st_as_sf(species_points, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

border_lonlat = disBorder("NSW")

tmap_mode("plot")

load("m_intensity_map.RDATA")
glm_m_multi_u_slides_map19 = m_intensity_map(grid_pred_lonlat, model_label = "Species 19")
print(glm_m_multi_u_slides_map19)
save(glm_m_multi_u_slides_map19, file = "glm_m_multi_u_slides_map19.RDATA")

tmap_save(glm_m_multi_u_slides_map19, "figures/glm_m_multi_u_slides_map19.png", width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 300)

```
